response.overview: Starring in this film is Reina Miyashita!! A cute, slender beauty with lovely, big, bright eyes and beautiful breasts!! Approximately one year after her last appearance, Reina Miyashita, whose cuteness and beauty have been further refined, has returned to appear in another REbecca production this year. In a space where no one can disturb her, she exudes her own eroticism and nihilistic presence, dominating the scene with an overwhelming aura. With each shed garment, she lets out a languid sigh, and her strong gaze seems to see through everything. Glamorous and serene, passionate and blank. Precisely because she doesn't speak, viewers are swept away and quietly absorbed by the rich world she creates. Untainted by anyone's hands, untouched by anyone... Reina Miyashita weaves an eternally solitary and exquisite time. The profound depths of beauty reigned by the queen of silence, woven in a secluded room in the city!!
